'''Hettitite''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Hettitite system/Legends|of the same name]], a part of the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Near-Human]] [[Sernpidalian|species]]<ref name="TEA" /> that had pale skin, [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Chewbacca">[[Chewbacca (2000) 4|''Chewbacca'' (2000) 4]]</ref>

At some point, Hettitite became threatened by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], and in [[365 BBY]], members of the native [[Species/Legends|species]] colonized the planet [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], eventually becoming known as Sernpidalans.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hettitite was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. The ''Atlas'' placed the planet in grid square M-2.<ref name="TEA" />
